title: Modal footer buttons must use Modal.ButtonRow, not a custom div/Stack, or focus rings get clipped
answers: focus ring cut off on buttons in modal
ConfirmModal button outline clipped at bottom
how to lay out buttons in a grafana-ui Modal footer
Modal.ButtonRow vs Stack for modal actions
body:
Symptom: when you tab to a button in a modal (e.g. ConfirmModal's Cancel/Delete), its keyboard focus ring is cut off at the edge.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx:ConfirmContent put its buttons in its own wrapper (a `buttonsContainer` div with paddingTop plus a `Stack`) instead of the modal's footer component.
Fix pattern: render action buttons as direct children of `Modal.ButtonRow` (imported from '../Modal/Modal'). Remove the custom spacing wrapper, because ButtonRow already handles footer spacing and layout.
Constraints: use this for any modal-style content in grafana-ui and in app code. After this change the `justifyButtons` prop of ConfirmContent is no longer passed to the button row (the Stack that used it is gone). Check that before you rely on that prop for alignment.
applies: Button footers in grafana-ui Modal/ConfirmModal and any custom modal content
